thread:
olivia_csm: Quick async check-in on Selene Corp renewal — customer reported webhook timeouts yesterday causing inference requests to backlog. Renew target EOW, CS needs confidence. What I know: error rate spike ~15:00 UTC, retries flooded dedicated pool, saw ~5-10s added p50 on gen endpoints. Any updates from eng? :exclamation:

mike_se: Looking into it now. Dashboard shows increase in 503/retry on the webhooks service + queue depth spike. KV cache miss rate up ~40% for the selene model variant. I've started trace collection.

sam_eng: I instrumented the handler and reproduced locally. Logs around the event (masked IDs):
```
2026-03-12T15:02:03Z [selene-webhook] WARN request_id=abc123 latency=5234ms upstream_timeout
2026-03-12T15:02:04Z [selene-webhook] ERROR request_id=abc124 runtimequeue=120 backlog
2026-03-12T15:02:05Z [selene-webhook] INFO request_id=abc125 retry=1 routed_to=backup-variant
```
I pushed a hotfix that increases the async worker pool and trims per-request timeouts to avoid long stalls: PR #842. Need review + a staging roll.

mike_se: @sam_eng reviewing now. Left an inline comment about a hard-coded `2s` in the handler — we should make that a config. If we can roll to staging + run a 10k request smoke test, we can push to prod on a fast path.

emma_csm: Renewals team asked for an ETA. Can we give them a safe window? Customer is on a renewal decision this week and SLA hiccups are sensitive.

sam_eng: Estimate: staging roll + 2h smoke tests -> prod rollout if green. If reviewers sign off in 30-60m we can target prod by EOD.

olivia_csm: Ok I'll tell the customer: "targeting staged fix within 3 hours, prod by EOD if smoke tests pass". Marking this high priority on the renewal. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy started for branch `hotfix/selene-worker-pool` to staging — build #1284 (status: queued)

mike_se: Quick ask — can someone from eng-infra confirm we didn't hit CPU throttling on the dedicated pools during the spike? @infra-team

infra-bot: Notifying #eng-infra for assistance — please report back if quotas or throttling observed.

sam_eng: Added a config toggle to revert the worker pool change if memory climbs. Snippet in the PR:
```
worker_pool_size = int(os.getenv("SELENE_WORKER_POOL", "24"))
worker_mem_limit = "2GB"
# toggle: SELENE_HOTFIX_ENABLED = true/false
```
Also added a short-circuit for requests that hit N retries to avoid queueing.

olivia_csm: tagging this as blocker for Selene renewal. I'll update the renewal tracker and ping again after staging smoke. Thanks all. :heart:
